defect_title: BPM Workflow Crash on Requisitions Between $5k and $25k
defect_description: Requisitions with amounts between $5000 and $25000 triggered unhandled null exception during Director routing.
root_cause: Misconfigured condition boundary in BPM rule: condition was evaluating '< 5000' and '> 25000' leaving intermediate tier unassigned.
resolution_action: Updated rule syntax to '>= 5000 AND <= 25000' pointing to Director of Operations position hierarchy.

defect_title: Tolerance Group Fails to Evaluate Percentage Threshold on Line Items
defect_description: Invoice with 1.2% price variance was incorrectly placed on Hold: Price Variance despite being within the 1.5% rule.
root_cause: Tolerance group was configured as an 'AND' condition requiring both percentage AND dollar thresholds to pass simultaneously instead of either/or.
resolution_action: Reconfigured tolerance group evaluation logic to apply standard percentage tolerance allowance (<= 1.5%).

defect_description: Entering lowercase supplier invoice numbers (e.g. 'inv-101' vs 'INV-101') bypassed duplicate invoice validation check.
root_cause: Duplicate check validation rule was performing exact binary string comparison rather than uppercase normalized comparison.
resolution_action: Applied UPPER() string normalization function to supplier invoice reference validation rule.

defect_title: Warehouse Dock Search Response Latency on High Line Count POs
defect_description: Searching for POs with > 10 lines took 8.5 seconds to return on warehouse ruggedized terminals.
root_cause: Missing database index on purchase order header status and receiving dock location fields.
discovered_by: po_status) improving query response time to 0.4 seconds.

defect_title: Payment Process Request Omits Remittance Email for Net 45 Vendors
defect_description: Automated payment run generated ACH payment trace but failed to trigger remittance advice emails for suppliers with Net 45 terms.
root_cause: Remittance delivery preference defaulted to 'Print Paper' rather than 'Email Notification' on the Net 45 supplier site template.
resolution_action: Updated supplier site template default configuration to 'Electronic Mail Delivery' and executed mass update.

defect_title: Audit History Table Truncates Justification Text on Rejections
defect_description: Manager rejection comment was truncated to 50 characters in the audit trail view.
root_cause: Audit history display field was bound to a legacy 50-character varchar variable.
resolution_action: Expanded display column width to 500 characters to capture full business justification rationale.

defect_title: Receiving Clerk Role Inadvertently Granted Invoice View Access
defect_description: Dock clerk user profile was able to query Accounts Payable voucher amounts via quick-search bar.
root_cause: Pre-packaged standard role included an inherited privilege for Payables Inquiry.
resolution_action: Cloned standard Receiving role into custom Northstar Receiving profile and revoked all Payables view privileges.

defect_title: Procurement Analytics Dashboard Tooltip Spelling Error
defect_description: Spend by Category chart tooltip displayed 'Raw Matreials' instead of 'Raw Materials'.
root_cause: Typographical error in static chart label mapping file.
resolution_action: Corrected spelling in chart metadata dictionary.
